title: SimpsonsVQA: Enhancing Inquiry-Based Learning with a Tailored Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing and benchmarking a Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset based on cartoon imagery. Although it includes sections on ethical considerations and potential negative societal impacts (including a mention of bias), these are standard discursive sections and do not constitute a core component of evaluating or benchmarking ethics, morals, or religious/spiritual traditions.
